facts.material: electrical heating unit with controls; disposable plastic fluid-path sets
facts.function: warms dialysis fluid to body temperature before it reaches the patient during home hemodialysis with the NxStage system
facts.form: stand-alone electric warmer plus single-use disposable warmer sets
facts.end_use: medical (dialysis) use with NxStage dialysis apparatus

gri_path: Section XVI note 1(m) and Section XVII-style exclusions not relevant; chapter 90 note 1 does not exclude it; heading 9018 covers instruments and appliances used in medical sciences, including electro-medical apparatus

Chapter 90 note 2(b): the warmer and its disposable sets are not goods of a specific heading and are suitable solely or principally for use with NxStage dialysis apparatus, so they are classified with that apparatus
GRI 6: 9018.90 other instruments > 9018.90.75 other (electro-medical) > 9018.90.75.70 parts and accessories of dialysis instruments and apparatus

rejected_alternatives.reason: the warmer does not itself perform dialysis; it is an accessory to the dialysis system
residual line; the warmer is dedicated to dialysis apparatus, which has its own parts-and-accessories line
chapter 85 heaters are displaced by the more specific medical provision of 9018 for goods used in medical sciences

missing_facts: Is the warmer used exclusively with the NxStage dialysis cycler, or is it a general-purpose medical fluid warmer?
classification.rationale: The FW-300 fluid warmer and its disposable sets heat dialysis fluid for use with the NxStage dialysis system, so they are medical appliances of heading 9018 rather than general electric heaters. Under chapter 90 note 2(b), accessories suitable solely or principally for dialysis apparatus are classified with it, giving 9018.90.75.70 (parts and accessories of dialysis instruments and apparatus). H81049 placed an electrically heated IV fluid warmer in 9018.90.75, and N351497 used 9018.90.7570 for hemodialysis console components.
